title: Question 9
passage:
I can pick up the curtains after work, unless you need the car.
A. The store has them in two different lengths. B. Go ahead. I'll be taking the train tonight. C. I took the old curtains down last week.
passageZh:
除非你需要用車，不然我下班後可以去取窗簾。
A. 店裡有兩種不同長度。 B. 你去吧，我今晚會搭火車。 C. 上星期我把舊窗簾拆下來了。
